questions.stem: A box plot has min $= 5$, $Q_1 = 12$, median $= 18$, $Q_3 = 25$, max $= 40$. The median line is closer to $Q_1$ than $Q_3$. What does this suggest?

options.text: The data has a positive skew (skewed right)
The data has a negative skew (skewed left)

questions.explanation: When the median is closer to $Q_1$, the upper half of the box is longer, and the upper whisker tends to be longer too. This indicates a positive (right) skew — data is stretched out towards higher values.
